content.title: About
content.content: Chicken is a popular source of lean protein obtained from poultry meat. This product uses only skinless meat, which reduces fat and calorie content. Chicken can be prepared by boiling, baking, frying, stewing, or steaming.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chicken is the most consumed type of meat worldwide.
Chicken meat is rich in essential amino acids needed for tissue growth and repair.
Skinless chicken contains roughly half the fat of meat with skin.
Chicken eggs and meat are staples in traditional dishes across many cultures.
Chicken can be raised in industrial or farm settings, affecting its nutritional profile.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Chicken provides a complete source of protein essential for maintaining muscle mass and metabolism.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: Removing the skin dramatically lowers saturated fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Chicken supplies niacin (B3) and pyridoxine (B6), which support energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: It contains phosphorus, selenium, and zinc, important for bones, immunity, and antioxidant protection.

items.title: Low calorie density
items.content: 100 g of skinless chicken breast provides about 110 kcal, helpful for weight management.

items.title: Bacterial contamination
items.content: Raw chicken may harbor Salmonella or Campylobacter, so it must be cooked thoroughly to an internal temperature of 75 °C.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken proteins.

items.title: Excess sodium
items.content: Marinating or using pre‑made sauces can increase the sodium content.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Skinless chicken breast can be diced, sliced, or cooked whole. It can be boiled in broth, baked with herbs, pan‑fried with minimal oil, or steamed. Cooked chicken is used in salads, soups, stews, sandwiches, and pasta dishes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store fresh chicken in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C for up to 2 days. For longer storage, freeze in an airtight bag at –18 °C for up to 9 months. Thaw in the refrigerator, not at room temperature.
